# Statistics browser fixtures

The native latest, dashboard and source-vector payloads are **synthetic contract fixtures**. Their opaque observation and classification IDs, source coordinates, dimension/member codes, revision and publication hash are test-only values. Labels and display amounts retain examples from the earlier fixtures; they do not establish source-series identity, current values, population authority or geographic correctness. These tests verify UI behavior, not migration/data parity.

Unmodified catalog/search and legacy landing decade/example payloads retain their earlier fixture shapes. They are not evidence of native-source validation. The dataset detail vector is one complete page plus a separate related-catalog response.
